intro.text: A religious teacher whose ideas gave rise to Shu-Keseg and, through it, to Shu-Korath and Shu-Dereth.

items.text: He preached the unity of all people without making clear what kind of unity he meant, and readers since have taken it as unity of mind, of love or of obedience. Shu-Keseg grew out of his teaching, and from it came both Shu-Korath and Shu-Dereth.
